exception_reasons.owner: Doctor native header schemes and subscription diagnostic envelope
exception_reasons.reason: GET probes must use the wire-required header while remaining non-inference and never refreshing subscription tokens; diagnostic parsing deliberately withholds arbitrary bodies.
Pre-refactor evaluator inputs remain frozen comparison evidence; changing that independent map would invalidate the baseline.
The credential-free scripted demo does not contact any model transport.
Native children must remove inherited keys without loading BEAM; a shared Rust policy is checked against Registry.secret_env and exercised through the real runner.
Historical rate-card schema order differs from setup priority; a registry conformance check requires exact coverage and uniqueness of all billable routes.

exception_reasons.reason: Transport preserves its existing stream_error/1 and /2 convenience calls for ChatGPT diagnostics; adapters with another provider pass that identity explicitly. The bounded diagnostic envelope belongs to the transport, while Registry supplies provider-specific hints and billing metadata.
